title: Flutter Developer
description:
**Company Description**
Alodi Robotics is a technology company focused on building innovative hardware and software products that address real-world challenges through intelligent systems. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Trivandrum, Kerala, India, the company integrates robotics, automation, artificial intelligence, and smart systems to improve productivity, safety, and efficiency across industries. Alodi Robotics manages end-to-end product development—from research and prototyping to engineering, testing, and deployment—supported by a multidisciplinary R&D team. Using technologies such as embedded systems, computer vision, machine learning, and connected hardware, the company delivers scalable, reliable solutions with intuitive workflows and smart analytics. Alodi values innovation, reliability, adaptability, and customer-centric design, partnering with organizations to transform complex challenges into impactful products.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Flutter Developer role based in Kerala, India. The Flutter Developer will design and build high-quality mobile applications using Flutter, Dart, and related tooling, ensuring smooth performance and robust architecture across Android and iOS. Daily responsibilities include collaborating with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to translate requirements into scalable features, integrating APIs and connected hardware services, and maintaining clean, testable code. The role involves debugging and optimizing existing applications, writing unit and integration tests, participating in code reviews, and contributing to documentation and best practices. The developer will work closely with the R&D team to support prototypes and production-grade applications that align with Alodi Robotics’ intelligent systems and smart product ecosystem.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Computer Science, including algorithms, data structures, and software architecture.
* Proficiency in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), with hands-on experience using Dart and at least one other modern language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, C#, or Python).
* Experience in Software Development, including full lifecycle development, testing, debugging, and deployment of mobile or cross-platform applications.
* Exposure to Back-End Web Development, RESTful APIs, and integration of mobile apps with cloud or on-premise services.
* Demonstrated experience developing Flutter applications, including state management (e.g., Provider, Bloc, Riverpod), responsive UI, and performance optimization.
* Familiarity with mobile development tooling and workflows (Git, CI/CD pipelines, app store deployment, analytics and crash reporting tools).
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, communicate clearly, and translate technical concepts into actionable tasks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with robotics, IoT, connected hardware, or data-driven applications is a plus.

title: Vice President of Operations
description:
**Unternehmensbeschreibung**
Mindteck ist seit über 30 Jahren ein international tätiger Engineering- und IT-Dienstleister und unterstützt Marktführer sowie innovative Start-ups in Bereichen wie Life Sciences, Industrieautomation, Gesundheitswesen, Halbleiter und Datenspeicherung. Das Unternehmen entwickelt Lösungen von eingebetteten Systemen bis hin zu KI-gestützten Plattformen und begleitet seine Kundschaft über den gesamten Technologie-Lebenszyklus – von der Idee und dem Prototyping bis zur Fertigungsreife und digitalen Transformation. Mindteck verfügt über ausgewiesene Expertise in KI- und Datendiensten, IoT- und Embedded-Systemen, Produktentwicklung sowie Qualitätsengineering und Testing nach CMMI Level 5 Standards. Mit Hauptsitz in Bengaluru und Standorten unter anderem in den USA, Europa und Asien bietet Mindteck globale Reichweite mit lokaler Betreuung. Als börsennotiertes Unternehmen und Gründungsmitglied der „Atlas of Economic Complexity“-Initiative der Harvard University versteht sich Mindteck als verlässliche Partnerin für komplexe, hochkritische Technologie- und Engineering-Projekte.
  
**Rollenbeschreibung**
Als Front-End-Entwicklungsassistent:in unterstützen Sie das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung und Pflege moderner Weboberflächen für interne und externe Anwendungen. Zu Ihren täglichen Aufgaben gehören die Mitarbeit bei der Implementierung von Benutzeroberflächen, die Vorbereitung von UI-Komponenten, die Dokumentation von Anforderungen sowie die Koordination kleiner Teilaufgaben im Projektablauf. Sie arbeiten eng mit Front-End-Entwickler:innen, UX/UI-Design und Projektmanagement zusammen, um eine hohe Qualität und Nutzerfreundlichkeit sicherzustellen. Die Position ist in Vollzeit angelegt, wird vor Ort ausgeübt und befindet sich in der Greater Kolkata Area. Zudem tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Entwicklungsprozessen und zur Evaluierung neuer Front-End-Technologien bei.
  
**Qualifikationen**

* **Analytische und Forschungsfähigkeiten:**
  Sie sollten über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung in Recherche und Informationsaufbereitung verfügen, um technische Anforderungen und Nutzerbedürfnisse strukturiert zu erfassen.
* **Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit:**
  Sie sollten klare, zielgruppenorientierte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mitbringen, um effektiv mit Entwickler:innen, Designer:innen und Projektbeteiligten zu arbeiten und Ergebnisse verständlich zu präsentieren.
* **Administrative Unterstützung und Organisation:**
  Sie sollten in administrativer Assistenz und organisatorischen Tätigkeiten geübt sein, etwa bei Terminabstimmung, Dokumentation und der Pflege projektbezogener Unterlagen.
* **Projektmanagement-Grundlagen:**

title: Associate I - Engineering Design
description:
**Role Description**
***Who we are:***
At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .
  
  
**Summary**
UST is seeking an experienced AutoCAD Customization Engineer for a full-time role based in Surat (work from office), to develop, enhance, and maintain CAD automation solutions using AutoLISP, Visual LISP, VBA, and .NET APIs. You will work closely with design and engineering teams to automate repetitive drafting tasks, improve productivity, and integrate AutoCAD workflows with enterprise systems.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Develop and maintain AutoCAD customization solutions using AutoLISP and Visual LISP.
* Create automation tools, custom commands, dialogs, and scripts to improve drafting efficiency.
* Develop AutoCAD plug-ins using the C#/.NET API.
* Customize drawing templates, standards, title blocks, and libraries.
* Automate BOM generation, drawing validation, and reporting processes.
* Integrate AutoCAD with external databases, ERP, PLM, and document management systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve AutoCAD customization and performance issues.
* Collaborate with engineering and design teams to gather automation requirements.
* Prepare technical documentation and user guides.
* Provide support and training to end users.
* Deliver CAD automation utilities and plug-ins, automated drafting and validation workflows, custom AutoCAD commands and user interfaces, productivity improvement solutions for engineering teams, and technical documentation and deployment support.

**What You Need**

* 3–6 years of experience, including at least 3 years in AutoCAD customization.

**Required Skills**

* Strong expertise in AutoLISP and Visual LISP.
* Good understanding of AutoCAD customization architecture.
* Experience in developing custom CAD automation workflows.
* Knowledge of drawing standards and engineering documentation.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with the AutoCAD .NET API (C# or VB.NET).
* Knowledge of ObjectARX.
* Experience integrating AutoCAD with ERP/PLM systems.
* Familiarity with SQL Server and database connectivity.
* Experience with Autodesk Inventor or Civil 3D customization.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial engineering, EPC, or AEC domains.
* Exposure to CAD automation and digital engineering initiatives.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**What We Believe**
*We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. And today, it's those same values that are inspiring us to encourage innovation from everyone, to champion diversity and inclusion and to place people at the centre of everything we do.*
**Humility**
*We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.*
**Humanity**
*Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.*
**Integrity**
*We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.*
***Equal Employment Opportunity Statement***
*UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation.*
*All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.*
*UST*
*reserves the right to periodically redefine your roles and responsibilities based on the requirements of the organization and/or your performance.*

* To support and promote the values of UST.
* Comply with all Company policies and procedures

**Skills**
AutoCAD, AutoCAD API, AutoLISP, C#, .NET, Microsoft SQL Server, VBA, ObjectARX

title: Advanced Engineer - Technology Development-Computer Vision
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
**Senior Engineer / Advanced Engineer - Technology Development-Computer Vision**
**About The Role**
We are seeking a passionate and innovative
**Senior Engineer - Technology Development (Computer Vision)**
to develop next-generation perception technologies that enable advanced 3D understanding, localization, mapping, and scene interpretation. This role combines cutting-edge research with practical engineering to create scalable, production-ready computer vision solutions using monocular and stereo imaging systems.
  
  
You will work on challenging problems involving computer vision, multi-view geometry, sensor calibration, SLAM/VINS, deep learning, and 3D reconstruction while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to bring innovative technologies into real-world applications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and optimize computer vision solutions using monocular and stereo camera systems.
* Build and validate 3D localization, mapping, SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping), and VINS (Visual Inertial Navigation System) pipelines.
* Develop algorithms for:

+ 3D reconstruction
+ Multi-view geometry
+ Depth estimation
+ Camera pose estimation
+ Scene understanding

* Perform camera modeling and calibration for pinhole, fisheye, and stereo vision systems.
* Apply both classical computer vision techniques and deep learning-based approaches for perception applications.
* Develop data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation pipelines.
* Implement and optimize solutions using Python, C++, OpenCV, and Point Cloud Library (PCL).
* Deploy, monitor, and improve AI/ML solutions on Linux-based systems and cloud platforms such as Azure ML Studio.
* Analyze performance bottlenecks, debug issues, and continuously improve solution robustness and accuracy.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to translate research concepts into scalable products.

What You'll Be Working On
  
  

* Advanced Computer Vision Systems
* Stereo & Monocular Perception
* 3D Localization & Mapping
* Visual SLAM / VINS
* Depth Estimation Models
* Human Pose Estimation
* Object Detection Systems
* Camera Calibration & Sensor Fusion
* Cloud-Based AI/ML Deployment
* Next-Generation Perception Technologies

**Required Technical Skills**
Computer Vision & 3D Perception
  
  

* Monocular and Stereo Vision Systems
* Multi-view Geometry
* Camera Calibration
* 3D Reconstruction
* Depth Estimation
* Scene Understanding
* Visual Localization
* Human Pose Estimation

Machine Learning & Deep Learning
  
  

* CNN-based Object Detection
* Depth Estimation Networks
* Human Pose Estimation Models
* Model Evaluation & Validation
* Data Annotation and Dataset Development

Programming & Tools
  
  

* Python
* C++
* OpenCV
* Point Cloud Library (PCL)
* NumPy
* Pandas
* Linux Development Environment

Cloud & Deployment
  
  

* Azure ML Studio
* Cloud-based ML Workflows
* Model Deployment and Monitoring

**Preferred Experience**
We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience in:
  
  

* Developing computer vision applications for real-world deployment.
* Building and deploying SLAM, VINS, or localization systems.
* Camera calibration and stereo vision pipeline development.
* 3D mapping and reconstruction technologies.
* Working with deep learning models such as:

+ Depth Anything
+ OpenPose
+ Object Detection Frameworks

* End-to-end AI/ML model development and deployment on cloud platforms.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Customer Focus
* Global Perspective
* Innovation Mindset
* Sound Decision Making
* Execution Excellence
* Accountability
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Leadership and Influence
* People Development
* Trust Building

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
  
  
In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
  
  
**More lives saved – more life lived!**

title: Lead AI / Agentic Platform Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Lead AI / Agentic Platform Architect**
with strong hands-on expertise in designing, architecting, and engineering LLM-powered and agentic AI solutions.

The candidate should also be comfortable working in the
**US EST time zone**
to ensure close collaboration with the client team. The ideal candidate should have practical experience building and orchestrating AI agents, integrating LLMs, designing agent runtimes, implementing tool integrations, and establishing scalable, secure, and governed AI platforms. This role requires someone who can evaluate existing agentic AI architectures, understand platform dependencies, define technical standards, establish evaluation frameworks, and identify gaps in safety, security, and AI governance. The candidate should be equally comfortable with architecture-level decisions and hands-on technical implementation.

**Work Schedule:**
Must be flexible and willing to work in the US Eastern Standard Time (EST) time zone.

**Responsibilities include:**

**Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Engineering**

* Design and architect scalable, enterprise-grade agentic AI platforms and solutions.
* Define agent orchestration patterns, runtime architecture, workflows, and multi-agent communication mechanisms.
* Architect prompt engineering frameworks, tool calling, connectors, and model integration strategies.
* Design memory management, state persistence, and context management mechanisms.
* Evaluate and implement RAG architectures and vector database integrations wherever applicable.

**LLM & AI Integration**

* Design and integrate LLM-based applications using leading commercial and open-source models.
* Establish model integration patterns, routing, fallback mechanisms, and model selection strategies.
* Define reusable components and frameworks for agent development and deployment.
* Optimize model performance, latency, scalability, and token consumption.

**AI Evaluation, Monitoring & Observability**

* Define evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Establish mechanisms for testing prompts, tools, workflows, and end-to-end agent behaviour.
* Implement telemetry, monitoring, tracing, and observability for agentic systems.
* Define mechanisms to identify hallucinations, failures, and performance bottlenecks.

**AI Safety, Security & Governance**

* Identify and address security and governance gaps in agentic AI architectures.
* Establish guardrails for responsible AI implementation, including access controls and data protection.
* Define policies for tool permissions, human-in-the-loop controls, and agent execution boundaries.
* Ensure appropriate compliance, auditability, and governance standards are incorporated into the architecture.

**Technical Leadership & Architecture Assessment**

* Assess existing AI and agentic platform architectures and map technical dependencies.
* Identify architecture gaps, integration challenges, scalability risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend target-state architecture and implementation roadmaps.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.

Primary Skills :

* 5+ years of experience in software architecture, AI engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles, including recent hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic AI systems.
* Strong understanding of agent orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes, multi-agent systems, and workflow automation.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, function calling, and tool orchestration.
* Experience designing memory, state management, context handling, and RAG-based architectures.
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Experience implementing AI guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability solutions.
* Strong understanding of AI security, governance, data privacy, and responsible AI principles.
* Ability to assess complex architectures, identify dependencies, and recommend scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Secondary Skills :

* Experience with frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI ecosystems such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or Azure AI Search.
* Familiarity with agent evaluation tools, tracing, and monitoring frameworks.
* Experience designing enterprise AI platforms with security, scalability, and cost optimization considerations.

title: MEP BIM Engineer
description:
**Location :- Indore**  
**Experience :- 3 to 8**  
**Job Description :-**

**What We're Looking For**

* **B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.**
* Experience in Plumbing BIM Modelling and Coordination.
* Proficiency in Autodesk Revit MEP, Autodesk Revit Fabrication, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and ACC/BIM 360.
* Strong understanding of BEP, CDE, LOD, ISO 19650, and QA/QC processes.
* Experience delivering international projects.
* Strong working knowledge of Dynamo and/or Python scripting, with proven ability to build automation tools that improve team-wide BIM workflow efficiency.

**Technical Expertise**

* Domestic hot and cold water supply systems, including pipe sizing and routing.
* Sanitary drainage, waste, and vent (DWV) systems.
* Storm water and rainwater drainage, including rainwater harvesting systems.
* Fire fighting systems: sprinklers, hydrants, hose reels, and wet/dry riser networks.
* Pump room layouts, water treatment, and booster pump system coordination.
* Coordination of pipe supports, insulation, and access provisions for maintenance.
* Codes and standards: IPC, UPC, BS EN 806/752, NFPA 13/14/20.
* Advanced coordination of complex pipe routing and riser layouts in high-density MEP zones.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
